drivingQuestion: Do הרי את לעצמך and אין לי עסק בך effect full release?
outcomeNote: אין לי עסק בך is shown to be a formula of manumission via Rav Sheshet's gloss of ono

segments.he: – לֹא אָמַר וְלֹא כְּלוּם. אָמַר לָהּ לְשִׁפְחָתוֹ: ״הֲרֵי אַתְּ מוּתֶּרֶת לְכׇל אָדָם״ – לֹא אָמַר וְלֹא כְּלוּם.
segments.en: «he has said nothing,» as this statement is not a valid expression of divorce. Similarly, if a master «said to his female» Canaanite «slave» upon emancipating her: «You are hereby permitted to any man, he has not said anything.»

segments.he: אָמַר לָהּ לְאִשְׁתּוֹ: ״הֲרֵי אַתְּ לְעַצְמְךָ״ מַהוּ? מִי אָמְרִינַן לִמְלָאכָה קָאָמַר לַהּ, אוֹ דִילְמָא לִגְמָרֵי קָאָמַר לַהּ?
segments.en: The Gemara addresses a less straightforward case: If a man «said to his wife: You are hereby for yourself, what is» the halakha? «Do we say» that «he said» this «to her only with regard to work?» In other words, he might have meant that she may keep her earnings. «Or perhaps he said to her» that she is on her own «entirely,» i.e., she is divorced.

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רָבִינָא לְרַב אָשֵׁי: תָּא שְׁמַע, דְּתַנְיָא: גּוּפוֹ שֶׁל גֵּט שִׁחְרוּר: ״הֲרֵי אַתָּה בֶּן חוֹרִין״, ״הֲרֵי אַתָּה לְעַצְמְךָ״. הַשְׁתָּא וּמָה עֶבֶד כְּנַעֲנִי דִּקְנֵי לֵיהּ גּוּפֵיהּ, כִּי אָמַר לֵיהּ ״הֲרֵי אַתָּה לְעַצְמְךָ״ – לִגְמָרֵי קָאָמַר לֵיהּ, אִשָּׁה דְּלָא קְנֵי לֵיהּ גּוּפַהּ, לֹא כׇּל שֶׁכֵּן?
segments.en: «Ravina said to Rav Ashi: Come» and «hear» a proof, «as it is taught» in a baraita: «The essence of a bill of manumission» is the expression: «You are hereby a freeman,» or: «You are hereby for yourself. Now» consider, «if» in the case of «a Canaanite slave, whose body belongs to» the master, even so, «when» the master «says to him: You are hereby for yourself,» this is considered as though «he said to him» that he «is entirely» on his own and is freed, then «all the more so» is it «not» clear «that a wife, whose body is not owned» by her husband, is divorced by means of this expression?

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רָבִינָא לְרַב אָשֵׁי: אָמַר לְעַבְדּוֹ ״אֵין לִי עֵסֶק בְּךָ״ מַאי? מִי אָמְרִינַן ״אֵין לִי עֵסֶק בְּךָ״ – לִגְמָרֵי קָאָמַר לֵיהּ, אוֹ דִילְמָא לִמְלָאכָה קָאָמַר לֵיהּ?
segments.en: With regard to the same issue, «Ravina said to Rav Ashi:» If «one said to his» Canaanite «slave: I have no business with you, what» is the halakha? «Do we say» that when «he said to him: I have no business with you,» he meant «entirely,» and therefore the slave is freed? «Or» did he «perhaps say» this «to him with regard to labor?» In other words, it is possible that the master is relieving the slave of his obligation to perform labor without actually emancipating him from slavery.

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב נַחְמָן לְרַב אָשֵׁי וְאָמְרִי לַהּ רַב חָנִין מָחוֹזָאָה לְרַב אָשֵׁי: תָּא שְׁמַע: הַמּוֹכֵר עַבְדּוֹ לְנׇכְרִי – יָצָא לְחֵירוּת, וְצָרִיךְ גֵּט שִׁחְרוּר מֵרַבּוֹ רִאשׁוֹן.
segments.en: «Rav Naḥman said to Rav Ashi, and some say Rav Ḥanin from Meḥoza» said «to Rav Ashi: Come» and «hear:» With regard to «one who sells his» Canaanite «slave to a gentile,» the slave «is emancipated but» nevertheless «requires a bill [get] of manumission from his first master.» In this manner the Sages penalized this owner for preventing the slave from fulfilling the mitzvot in which he is obligated.

segments.he: אָמַר רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל: בַּמֶּה דְּבָרִים אֲמוּרִים – שֶׁלֹּא כָּתַב עָלָיו אוֹנוֹ, אֲבָל כָּתַב עָלָיו אוֹנוֹ – זֶהוּ שִׁחְרוּרוֹ. הֵיכִי דָּמֵי אוֹנוֹ? אָמַר רַב שֵׁשֶׁת: דִּכְתַב לֵיהּ: כְּשֶׁתִּבְרַח מִמֶּנּוּ – ״אֵין לִי עֵסֶק בְּךָ״.
segments.en: «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says» in addition to this: «In what» case «is this statement said?» This is referring to a situation «where he did not write a document [ono] for» the slave when he sold him to the gentile. «But» if «he wrote a document for him, this» itself «is his emancipation.» The Gemara asks: «What are the circumstances» of this «document? Rav Sheshet said» that «he writes to him: When you escape from him I have no business with you.» This indicates that the formula: I have no business with you, is a valid expression of emancipation.
